candidates.title: Remove a fixture-only volatile zero load
candidates.rationale: The profile attributes most observed fixture time to integer_sum. The translation-unit-local volatile value is initialized to zero and never modified, so its per-element load performs no useful work in this controlled fixture.
candidates.risk: Removing volatile access is generally unsafe for hardware or concurrently modified state. This candidate is valid only because the fixture variable is internal, fixed at zero, and has no writer.
candidates.expected_effect: Remove one volatile load and addition per element; the verifier must measure the actual effect.
